decisions.reason: The skin and hair supplement fits the firm's pharmacy consumer health line and costs little to keep on the market, but it has had no visible support since 2019, so the option stays open while its value remains unproven.
As an extension of the established Trivital brand, the joint supplement is cheap to carry, and no negative evidence has appeared, so keeping it is the better choice.

The mushroom-based immune supplement is a weakly presented niche product, but post-pandemic interest in immune products keeps its upside uncertain and its carrying cost is low, so it stays for now with a higher risk of being dropped.
The OTC triptan sits in a regulated, comparatively valuable self-medication niche that is still early in its life, so the option is worth keeping despite the lack of website evidence.
